components.name: Key
components.description: Beveled obsidian control for Send, Voice, Mute, End, and Start conversation.
components.css: .ds-key { min-height: 56px; min-width: 7.5rem; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid #58e6c2; border-radius: 4px; background: #071116; color: #f2eadf; font-family: "Martian Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; box-shadow: inset 1px 1px 0 #3d7a70, inset -1px -1px 0 #0a1c20; cursor: pointer; } .ds-key:hover { background: #123036; color: #58e6c2; } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #58e6c2; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-key:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; color: #2a6f62; background: #081014; }

components.name: Message field
components.description: Labeled composer textarea with a legend sitting on the mint stroke.
components.css: .ds-message { position: relative; display: grid; padding-top: 8px; font-family: "Martian Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-message-label { position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 0; padding: 0 8px; background: #0d2024; color: #64a08c; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-message-field { width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #58e6c2; border-radius: 4px; background: #08141a; color: #f2eadf; resize: none; box-shadow: inset 1px 1px 0 #3d7a70, inset -1px -1px 0 #0a1c20; caret-color: #58e6c2; } .ds-message-field::placeholder { color: #6e9a96; } .ds-message-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #58e6c2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Transcript window
components.description: Beveled panel for the conversation well, with uppercase chrome and a 32px cell grid.
components.html:
Transcript · 2 entriesAgent Core · Live

  1. You Hello

  2. Alex Ready when you are.
components.css: .ds-window { border: 1px solid #58e6c2; background: #0d2024; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: inset 1px 1px 0 #3d7a70, inset -1px -1px 0 #0a1c20; color: #f2eadf; font-family: "Martian Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; overflow: hidden; } .ds-window-bar { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #58e6c2; color: #64a08c; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-transcript { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 16px; display: grid; gap: 16px; } .ds-entry { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 16px minmax(0, 1fr); column-gap: 16px; align-items: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-mark { justify-self: center; margin-top: 0.35em; background: #58e6c2; } .ds-plus { width: 12px; height: 12px; background: linear-gradient(#58e6c2, #58e6c2) center / 100% 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#58e6c2, #58e6c2) center / 2px 100% no-repeat; } .ds-diamond { width: 10px; height: 10px; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-copy { margin: 0; min-width: 0; } .ds-copy strong { display: inline-block; min-width: 4ch; font-weight: 700; } .ds-entry[data-role="assistant"] strong { color: #58e6c2; } .ds-dash { display: inline-block; width: 1.1em; height: 2px; margin: 0 8px; background: #f2eadf; vertical-align: middle; } .ds-entry[data-role="assistant"] .ds-dash { background: #58e6c2; }

components.name: Identity select
components.description: Custom listbox for identity choice: sibling legend, left-aligned value, pointer-down commit, themed overlay.
components.html:
• Alex — Speaking examiner

components.css: .ds-select { position: relative; width: 100%; font-family: "Martian Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-select-trigger { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid #58e6c2; border-radius: 4px; background: #08141a; color: #f2eadf; text-align: left; box-shadow: inset 1px 1px 0 #3d7a70, inset -1px -1px 0 #0a1c20; cursor: pointer; } .ds-select-trigger:hover { background: #0a1820; } .ds-select-trigger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #58e6c2; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-select-value { padding: 16px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-select-chevron { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 3rem; min-height: 54px; border-left: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #58e6c2 35%, transparent); } .ds-select-chevron::before { content: ""; width: 10px; height: 6px; background: #64a08c; clip-path: polygon(50% 100%, 0 0, 100% 0); } .ds-select-list { position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 8px); left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 30; margin: 0; padding: 8px; list-style: none; border: 1px solid #58e6c2; border-radius: 4px; background: #0d2024; box-shadow: inset 1px 1px 0 #3d7a70, inset -1px -1px 0 #0a1c20; } .ds-select-option { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 16px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: #f2eadf; } .ds-select-option.is-selected { color: #58e6c2; } .ds-select-option:hover { background: #123036; color: #58e6c2; } .ds-select-marker { width: 8px; height: 8px; } .ds-select-option.is-selected .ds-select-marker { background: #58e6c2; }

narrative.overview:
Agent Core is a sixteen-color dialogue field: a near-black Bayer-dithered plane, beveled mint windows, and one self-hosted mono. Presence is ordered-dither light in the HUD, talk docks as a bordered transcript, and Voice is the same session lighting mint. It is an operate surface for one identity and one conversation — personal and live, not an admin dashboard and not a marketing page.

Density is HUD-tight, then generous empty field. Status is labeled in type (Ready, Starting voice…, Listening, Reconnecting). Synthetic stays named. Motion is stepped phosphor, off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Confirmed rejections: cream-paper messengers, Fraunces/Source Sans pairings, bubble columns, fake inboxes, nested cards, Inter-on-white chat clones, smooth gradients, drop-shadow elevation, and native OS select menus.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed field with a 256px repeating dither tile; no centered paper column
1px mint stroke plus inset bevel on every window and key
One face (Martian Mono) at four sizes; no second family
HUD (wordmark, profile, ready, identity) + presence plate + transcript + key dock
Mint for live connection and focus; persimmon only for interrupt, fail, and error

rules.name: The Mint Is Live Rule
rules.body: Mint is connection, focus, and phosphor. Do not flood panels or keys with mint fill.

rules.name: The Persimmon Alarm Rule
rules.body: Persimmon appears only for interrupt, fail, and recoverable error — never as decoration or as the default Send key.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: One self-hosted mono for wordmark, HUD, messages, and keys. Do not introduce a serif display or a sans UI face.

rules.name: The Shared Inset Rule
rules.body: HUD, transcript, picker, and dock share one inset and one region gap. Do not mix percentage-absolute boxes with the token grid.

rules.name: The Shared Marker Column Rule
rules.body: HUD rows and transcript entries use a 16px marker column and 16px gap. Do not introduce a second icon family.

rules.name: The Bevel Not Drop Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit in the field. Do not add offset drop shadows or glass blur.

rules.name: The Labeled Key Rule
rules.body: Send, Voice, Cancel, Mute, Unmute, End, and Start conversation are visible text with those accessible names. Markers may accompany HUD copy; they are never the sole label.

rules.name: The Themed Listbox Rule
rules.body: Identity choice uses a custom listbox with field chrome and a panel overlay. The legend is a sibling of the control. Do not wrap the listbox in a native <label> and do not fall back to native browser select menus.

dos: Do keep HUD, transcript, picker, and dock on the shared inset/gap scale (40/16 desktop, 16/24 ≤879px).
Do self-host Martian Mono; honor `prefers-reduced-motion`; keep body contrast ≥ 4.5:1 on field/panel.
Do preserve testids `connection` and `profile`, and the accessible names Identity, Start conversation, Send, Voice, Cancel voice, Mute, Unmute, End.
Do keep the labeled composer visible while voice is live until `/docs` and tests change together.
Do render escaped plain text; mark interrupted/failed in type.
Do use the custom themed select for identity choice; keep the Identity legend as a sibling of the listbox; keep value text left-aligned and keys centered.
donts: Don't return to cream paper, Fraunces, Source Sans, or message bubbles.
Don't use drop shadows, glass blur, smooth gradients, or a second type family.
Don't fill keys or panels with mint; mint is the live line.
Don't replace Voice / Mute / End with icon-only or emoji controls.
Don't draw a fake inbox, session list, attachment dock, or in-chat agent switcher.
Don't hide status in animation or a color dot alone.
Don't ship Google Fonts or a raster wordmark when the live type is Martian Mono.
Don't use native browser select menus, wrapping `<label>` listboxes, or icon-only chevrons for identity pickers.
